significance: A pagoda-style Shiva temple at Naule Katuwal in Dullu Municipality of Dailekh District, worshipped as Sidheshwor Mahadev and sharing its precinct with shrines to Kalika Bhagwati, Ganesh, Kalsaini Bhairab and Batuk Bhairab; the article records that the saint Sagar Giri organised its worship and that its ritual regalia were restored in 1960 BS.
